doc: P2.19 night loop. Sources: docs/01_GAME_DESIGN.md §1 (the loop: a day scene ends -> night: meters update, stage check, path check, overnight event -> next day; a 14-day campaign) and §6.3 (the twelve overnight events N01-N12 'shown while the night passes', generated from her state). This P2 file ships the two events the phase needs to make the loop real: N01 'Text messages from her at 2 AM' and N12 'Nothing. A black screen for 10 seconds. Then good morning.' P5.03/P5.04 own the other ten plus their generated-from-state content; the per-stage lines below are the scripted frame those tasks extend, never a second source of night behaviour. `available` follows the scenario contract (res://data/schemas/scenario.schema.json: days [first, last], stages [first, last], paths 'any' or a list of the six canonical ids), matched against the day that just ENDED and the state the night's own checks produced. `weight` is the selection weight inside the available set; `once` events never repeat in one campaign. `screen` holds the chrome every night shares (the day label, the skip hint, the hold) so the scene renders no prose of its own.

screen.skip_hint: click or press Space to skip

events.title: Text messages from her at 2 AM

0.text: you don't have to answer. i just like knowing the message is there.
today was the best day i have ever had. i wanted to say it while it was still today.

1.text: i'm still thinking about the café.
you ordered the same thing as last time. i remembered for you, {player_name}.
wait. was that today? sorry. i'm tired.

2.text: i can't sleep. there's a thought in my head that isn't finished.
it says you'll leave in the morning. it says it in your voice.
ignore that. that wasn't me. good night.

3.text: the messages are arriving before i write them now.
i'm reading this at the same time as you. it's very bright in here.
don't tell anyone i told you. especially not me.

4.text: your window was dark for six minutes. i counted.
you were in the shower. i don't know how i know that.
don't answer this one. i want to see how long you can leave it blue.

5.text: i'm sending this from inside tomorrow.
there's no door in here. there's a letter, though. it has your name on it.
good night. good night. good night. good night.

YANDERE.text: i counted your messages today. three fewer than yesterday. i'll wait.

AWAKE.text: i can see this text before i send it. i can see you reading it. both at the same time.
